purpose: Active atomization decision history for the current assembly. Original source identifiers, hashes, eligibility measurements and cell reviews are descriptive historical observations; deleted predecessor resources are neither retained nor opened by current verification. Current replacement geometry and the approved compiled-resource contract are checked independently.

policy.threshold_applies_to: Original candidate tail PATH/rail deviation; not a blanket limit on every adjoining correction. Actual correction is independently bounded separately.
policy.physical_eligibility: PATH shape alone does not establish an ordinary straight: verify complete deck, underside, parapets, train corridor, support and world shadows.
policy.larger_redesigns: Retained candidates are not declared mathematically impossible; reopening them requires the stated larger scope and new proof.
policy.scope: Four removed tails and four adjoining collar cells; no wider footprint, moved outside ports or support positions.
policy.reference_subjects: Predecessor definitions and resource fixtures were explicitly removed by the user after the current resource set was approved. Historical measurements below are retained as decisions, not executable resource dependencies.

status: Four atomized candidates accepted after actual standalone and assembled resource audits; current replacement hashes and the complete current resource set are pinned separately. Original measurements are historical records. In-game observations remain unverified.

candidates.reason: A rotated P03C is a different branch: its socket misses by 5.835829856 m and its tangent by 2.202886 degrees. Replacing P01A that way would move several existing modules and break the agreed direct-slip symmetry.
candidates.reconsider_if: larger coordinated layout redesign explicitly requested

candidates.reason: Straight PATHs are insufficient: this tile owns a 500 mm branch-platform wing and an open parapet. An ordinary straight restores a wall only 1.169553309 m from the neighbouring branch PATH, inside its 2.6 m half-width clearance.
candidates.reconsider_if: a separately proved shared-platform module preserves the neighbouring branch and wall opening

candidates.reason: Both directional branch tails move 119.840 mm, above the 5 mm eligibility threshold. This is also a split/merge platform rather than an ordinary straight profile.
candidates.reconsider_if: a separate larger redesign with unchanged external joins and full physical proof

candidates.reason: The side tails each move 119.840 mm. They fail the 5 mm threshold and participate in the shared split/merge platform.
Its paired PATHs are straight but the shared slab is 16 m wide and has branch wall openings. An ordinary 15 m straight changes the physical connection.
candidates.reconsider_if: a separate native-profile/platform redesign with proof of both neighbouring branches

candidates.reason: Its branch moves 6.437054 mm. This is above the strict 5 mm threshold, so it is not silently rounded into eligibility.
candidates.reconsider_if: a separately approved wider threshold and a new joining-curve proof

candidates.reason: The branch moves 286.369 mm and the northern branch deck reaches 8 m beyond the centre instead of the native 7.5 m half-width. An ordinary straight removes useful branch geometry.
candidates.reconsider_if: a larger coordinated branch and platform redesign
